8435.html:
8435 prakāra¹ m. 'sort, manner' Kauś., prakāraiḥ 'in one way or another' R., kēna prakārēṇa 'how?' Pañcat. [√kr̥¹]
    Pa. pakāra- m. 'way, mode', Pk. payāra-, payara- m.; — inst. payarēṇa with further abnormal shortening of first syllable in an adverb > *pariṁ and with additional inst. suffix OG. pariiṁ 'in that manner'; Or. je pari 'in which way', peri, piri adv. 'like, as'; Mth. kon pari 'how?'; Marw. pari adv. 'like, as': from which a substantive was extracted in S. pari f. 'custom'; N. pari 'way, means, method'; G. pεrⁱ f. 'means'; M. par, parī f. 'way, manner, style, sort' (J. C. W.). — Not with J. Bloch, ThomasEIS 34, < *parīti-.

13211.html:
13211 samāná 'same, alike' RV., m. 'an equal' VS. [samá-¹]
    Pa. samāna- 'like, equal', Pk. samāṇa-, sām°; K. samān 'like, equal, average'; G. samāṇũ 'like, equal', Si. hamana EGS 189.
    samānayati, sāmānya-.

13119.html:
13119 sadŕ̥kṣa 'like' VS. [sa-², √dr̥ś]
    Pa. sarikkha-, °aka- 'like', Pk. sarikkha-, sariccha- adj., sārikkha-, sāriccha- adj. and n. sb.; S. sarkho 'like', P. sarīkkhā, sarkhā, Ku. sariko, H. sarīkhā, sarikā, poet. sārikhā (whence sārikhnā 'to liken, resemble'), OMarw. sārikho, OG. sarīkhaü, G. sarkhũ, M. sarsā(or < sadŕ̥śa-), poet. (← H.) sā̆rikhā, sārkhā, Si. suruka.
